s1.title: Register as Farmer
s1.desc: Create your free account in under 2 minutes.
s1.detail: Sign up with your phone number, select your state and district. No paperwork, no fees — just a quick profile and you're in.

s2.title: Post Your Requirement
s2.desc: Tell us what crop, machine type, and dates you need.
s2.detail: Select your crop type (paddy, wheat, soybean...), pick your harvest start date, and specify how many days you need a harvester. Done in seconds.

s3.title: Browse & Filter Matches
s3.desc: See verified operators and harvesters near you instantly.
s3.detail: Filter by district, machine brand, availability, and experience. View full profiles with ratings, past harvests, and contact info before you connect.

s4.title: Connect & Get Harvested
s4.desc: WhatsApp or message directly. Agree on terms. Harvest!
s4.detail: No middlemen. Contact the operator or owner directly via WhatsApp or the in-app message system. Agree on your rate, confirm dates, and your crop is harvested on time.

s1.title: Register as Operator
s1.desc: Create your operator profile and showcase your skills.
s1.detail: Register with your machine type, years of experience, and operating district. Add your photo and certifications to stand out to farmers looking for reliable operators.

s2.title: List Your Availability
s2.desc: Set your schedule and service areas so farmers find you.
s2.detail: Mark which months you're available, which districts you travel to, and what machines you can operate. Update anytime — you're always in control.

s3.title: Receive Requests
s3.desc: Farmers will find and contact you directly.
s3.detail: When a farmer posts a requirement matching your profile, they'll see you in search results. You'll get direct WhatsApp or in-app messages from interested farmers.

s4.title: Work & Earn
s4.desc: Confirm the job, head to the field, and earn fairly.
s4.detail: Agree on your daily rate directly with the farmer — no commission cuts, no middlemen. More work, better pay, and a growing reputation on the platform.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers to help you get the most out of Tractor Seva.

q1.question: What is Tractor Seva?
q1.answer: Tractor Seva is a digital platform connecting Indian farmers with harvester owners and tractor operators to easily rent agricultural machinery and hire skilled help.

q2.question: How do I book a harvester or hire an operator?
q2.answer: You can browse our verified directory of machines and operators, filter by your state or district, and contact the listings directly via our integrated real-time chat or WhatsApp.

q3.question: Is it free to list my machine or register as an operator?
q3.answer: Yes! Registering your profile as a tractor operator or listing your harvester is completely free. We do not charge any registration fees or listing fees.

q4.question: How does the service requests portal work?
q4.answer: If you are a farmer looking for specific machinery or help, you can post a Service Request. Operators and machine owners can browse these requests and contact you directly to offer their services.

q5.question: How are operators and machines verified?
q5.answer: We encourage community trust through our Rating & Review system. Users can rate operators and machines based on their direct experience. Always inspect machinery and discuss terms before finalizing payments.

q6.question: Can I use Tractor Seva in my local language?
q6.answer: Absolutely! Tractor Seva has complete multilingual localization support. You can switch between English, Marathi, and other regional languages using the language toggle in the navigation bar.
